Bid Summary.value: Procurement for municipal network equipment refresh including 24 48-port managed Layer 3 network switches, wireless access points, and firewall appliances. The contract term is three years with one optional one-year renewal. Equipment must be new, unused, and covered by manufacturer's standard warranty. A 5% bid bond is required, and payment terms are Net 30 days. The electronic bid submission deadline is November 25, 2026 at 2:00 PM EST (extended from Nov 18), and delivery is required within 75 calendar days after purchase order issuance (extended from 60 days).
